name: entity-classification
description: Minimal seed prompts for classifying text into agentic AI entity types (Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, Human). Archetypes drawn from Promptbreeder (Fernando et al., 2023) and MIPRO (Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024) research on prompt diversity.
seeds: Classify this text as Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, or Human.
Tell me the entity type: Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, or Human.
What type of entity is described? Choose: Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, Human.
Identify the entity category from: Agent, Task, Tool, Input, Output, Human.
